```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

pyramid <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/poblacio-vila-seca-edat-sexe-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

pyramid$age_bin <- cut(
  pyramid$age_years,
  breaks = c(seq(0, 100, by = 5), Inf),
  right = FALSE,
  labels = c(paste(seq(0, 95, by = 5), seq(4, 99, by = 5), sep = "-"), "100 i més")
)
pyramid$sex <- ifelse(pyramid$sex == "M", "Homes", "Dones")

agg <- aggregate(population ~ age_bin + sex, data = pyramid, FUN = sum)
agg$value <- ifelse(agg$sex == "Homes", -agg$population, agg$population)

fig <- ggplot(agg, aes(x = age_bin, y = value, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, position = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) format(abs(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Homes = "#2171b5", Dones = "#9ecae1")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Piràmide de població de Vila-seca per grups d'edat i sexe, 2021",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Habitants",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Font: Idescat, cens de 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit()

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/project-population-pyramid-vila-seca-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 7.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```
